title: Performance of Household Refrigerating Appliances — Refrigerators with or without Low Temperature Compartment

clauses.title: Storage Temperature Ratings (Fresh Food Compartment & Freezer)
clauses.text: Clause 5.1 & Table 1 (Storage Temperature Limits): In standard climate (T class, ambient 43°C): (a) Fresh food compartment temperature shall remain between 0.0°C and +4.0°C. (b) One-star freezer compartment <= -6.0°C; Two-star <= -12.0°C; Three-star and Four-star freezer compartment <= -18.0°C.

clauses.title: Pull-Down Test & Freezing Capacity Under Tropical Ambient (43°C)
clauses.text: Clause 7.2 (Pull-Down Test): When started from room temperature at 43°C ambient, the refrigerator shall cool all fresh food storage compartments below 7.0°C and freezer below -12.0°C within 3.5 hours of continuous operation.
